coder-bash-staggered-interlock.head: 524eff3096c7c1eb36cd9a35d47188406f14734a
coder-bash-staggered-interlock.scope: Stock suppressed both slots at rest and Bash before Stagger. After Stagger, Bash queued against the live selected dummy, played 289, paid 40 IS, sent 10/5 s reuse, hit 77 and 63 with +75 resistance, and sent matching four-second Stun and eight-second Enrage adds and removals. Low Blow independently confirmed 19/15, 30 IS, six-second reuse and 288.

targeting.source: GOB 605 requires an active fight in Coder Style and a selected opponent.
targeting.runtime: AbilityHandler restricts 605 to the loaded move and live current opponent in the same interlock before creating the pending special.
targeting.test: CoderSpecialsRequireTheLoadedMoveAndLiveCurrentOpponent covers ownership, live target and no-cost rejection. Stock PR881 suppresses it at rest and queues it against the selected Melee Dummy in ordinary Close Combat. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/881#issuecomment-7088359315

behavior-tests.source: GOB 605 specifies 30 IS, six-second reuse, Coder interlock and fixed damage without a control state.
behavior-tests.runtime: Ordinary interlock queue, contest, landing, typed damage and reuse paths handle 605 without injecting states.
